row.title: A wildcard zone route shadows a tenant custom domain
row.body: unlearn.ultrastable.app answered Not found from ultrastable-spinoffs because the zone route *.ultrastable.app/* catches the hostname before the Workers custom domain. The deployer (TENANT-ROUTE-1 in site/deployer.js) now adds a host route for the tenant worker whenever another worker's wildcard route covers its domain; a failure lands as a warning in the deploy detail.

title: A wildcard zone route shadows a tenant custom domain
